select_nvfp4_moe_backend: select the best NvFP4 MoE backend and kernel class for a given configuration and quantization keys
make_nvfp4_moe_kernel: create a FusedMoEKernel instance with prepare/finalize, experts, and shared experts for NvFP4 quantization
convert_to_nvfp4_moe_kernel_format: convert NvFP4 MoE layer weights and scales to the format required by the selected backend
make_nvfp4_moe_quant_config: build an FusedMoEQuantConfig object with NvFP4 scaling factors and activation scales for the chosen backend
backend_to_kernel_cls: map an NvFP4 MoE backend enum to its corresponding expert kernel classes
